# Genomic Selection Validation Contract

## Simulation Truth

- Genotypes/phenotypes, causal architecture, training/test or family split,
  model settings, selected-parent rule, mating design, number of cycles, seed,
  and retained true breeding values when simulation provides them.

## Required Results

- Training/test membership, predictions/GEBVs, model metrics, selected-parent
  table, crosses/offspring metadata, kinship/diversity summary, cycle summary,
  and parameter manifest.

## Required Figures

- Observed versus predicted phenotype or breeding value on held-out lines.
- Prediction accuracy/calibration by split or cycle.
- Genetic gain, selection differential, kinship/inbreeding, and family-representation plots over cycles.

## Pass Criteria

- Training and test labels are disjoint; family-aware splits avoid close-relative leakage when requested.
- Each cycle has a valid selected-parent set and recorded crossing decisions.
- Accuracy is reported only on held-out individuals; gain and diversity loss are both reported.
- Selection success is interpreted as a configured simulation outcome, not evidence that the same scheme improves a real breeding program.
